_doc: HAUSSMANN P0.5 (editorial gate, O2) — leak-lint pattern set. ONE source of truth, consumed by both site/tests/gates/gate-27-leak-lint.spec.ts and site/scripts/gen_leak_baseline.mjs. Classes derive from the B5 H13 annex (evidence/claims/claims_raw.json -> h13_leak_summary.class_counts; 58/74 vault pages leaking). Regexes are JSON-escaped source strings; `flags` is the RegExp flag string (the consumer forces `g`).
_scoping_note: These target machine-shaped internal identifiers — underscore-joined ids, release-train codes, raw enum values, operator machine names, unclosed-parenthetical truncation. NOT prose words: 'campaign' and 'mission' are legitimate public vocabulary on this site and are deliberately not matched; only `campaign_*` / `mission_*` IDS are.
_self_test: Every pattern carries `example` (MUST match) and `counter_example` (MUST NOT match). gate-27 asserts both — a regex typo that silently matches nothing, or a loosened regex that starts eating legitimate prose, fails the gate instead of quietly weakening it. Each counter_example is a real string from this tree that an earlier draft mis-flagged.

patterns.why: Internal campaign/mission artifact ids (campaign_rosetta, mission_wadna_p3_iterate). Case-sensitive by design — ids are lower_snake_case.
patterns.example: see campaign_haussmann and mission_p0_5 for detail
patterns.counter_example: Run a campaign, decompose it into a mission, and claim an objective.

patterns.why: The internal 'Production Tidy' release-train codes (pt08, pt09, pt12, pt13). Meaningless to a reader; the marquee H13 instance is the homepage card 'Renamed from TaskForge.aDNA (Production Tidy pt08.' H13 class: codename_jargon.
patterns.counter_example: The type scale steps from 10pt to 20pt across the display sizes.

patterns.why: Raw machine enum values rendered as human-facing labels ('Class: org_graph', 'Persona: tbd_at_p0'). H13 classes: raw_enum_spec (23) + raw_enum_lede_code_as_WHAT (7). Also the standing evidence under FALSE claims R-23/R-61 — 'every vault has its own persona' fails on the very pages that print `tbd_at_p0` as the persona.
patterns.counter_example: An aDNA vault is a knowledge graph an organization governs itself.

patterns.why: The truncated-lede signature: an OPEN parenthesis whose text is cut at a period, with no closing paren before the text node or attribute ends. Catches the largest H13 class (truncation_unclosed_paren, 27) — 'Web-stack cohort (.', '(Production Tidy pt08.' — a generator artifact of clipping a lede mid-parenthetical. TUNING (2026-08-16): the `[^)<"]` interior (rather than `[^)]`) is what separates a real truncation from a legitimate parenthetical containing inline markup; the counter_example below is the exact real-tree string that the looser draft mis-flagged.
patterns.example: Build-face software-element context graph. Web-stack cohort (.<
patterns.counter_example: harmonized (CLAUDE.md §Registry Awareness vs. the concept page)

patterns.why: Operator-machine identifiers on a public surface ('per-node operational governance for Mac/stanley; the operator's daily-driver'). Names a private machine and its role to any reader.
patterns.example: per-node operational governance for Mac/stanley; the operator's daily-driver
patterns.counter_example: Everything lives on your machine; clone the image and run it on your Mac.

patterns.why: Internal operation codenames (Operation Aegis / CAKE / Vitrine / Agora) and LIP proposal ids. H13 class: codename_jargon (14). NOTE: this vault's docs cite 'Operation Rosetta' pedagogically under Standing Order 8 — those uses are token-allowlisted per surface, never baselined.
patterns.example: Operation Aegis BI cohort; ratified under LIP-0005
patterns.counter_example: The operation of a vault is governed by its CLAUDE.md.

patterns.why: Vault-internal code-as-WHAT paths in registry ledes. H13 class: internal_path_lede (10). Deliberately an ENUMERATED list of leaking paths rather than a generic `what/*/` — the triad path vocabulary (what/context/, how/missions/) is legitimate public teaching material on this site.
patterns.counter_example: Knowledge objects live in what/context/ and plans in how/missions/.

patterns.why: Backlog idea ids and internal review-finding ids (F-CHM-214, KW-n). Unresolvable for a reader — there is no public artifact behind the id.
patterns.counter_example: The idea behind the triad is that every file answers one question.
